domain_claim: decode_record_payload rejects input slices where bytes.len() > RECORD_HEADER_BYTES + header.payload_len with JournalError::UnexpectedTrailingBytes { declared_end, actual_len }; accepts only when declared_end == actual_len.
notes: Existing Kani harness at crates/vb_storage/src/kani_postcard_envelope_wire_trailing_bytes.rs covers both directions (accepted when equal, rejected when trailing); trailing_bytes_proptests.rs provides proptest coverage. proof-planner should NOT re-author these; it should bind the existing harness to the canonical command path.

domain_claim: decode_record_payload rejects input slices where bytes.len() < RECORD_HEADER_BYTES + header.payload_len with JournalError::UnexpectedEof via bytes.get(payload_start..payload_end).ok_or(UnexpectedEof) and arithmetic checks (try_from, checked_add).
notes: Covers the truncation-side dual of PS-SEED-001. Arithmetic overflow guards are explicit in the source; proof-planner should verify that any future refactor preserves the try_from/checked_add chain.

domain_claim: decode_record_payload calls verify_digest_match(payload, header.payload_digest); mismatch returns JournalError::PayloadDigestMismatch.
notes: Existing Flux refinement at crates/vb_storage/src/codec/flux_validation.rs is artifact-only pending flux_rs dependency; proof-planner should re-enable or replace with Kani/Verus equivalent.

domain_claim: put_workflow_source calls verify_content_digest(record.source, record.digest.as_bytes()); mismatch returns JournalError::PayloadDigestMismatch BEFORE any key derivation or insert.
notes: Existing behavior test at crates/vb_storage/src/journal/tests.rs::verify_content_digest_rejects_mismatch (line 638). proof-planner should bind.

domain_claim: put_compiled_ir rejects any second write whose metadata_hash differs from the existing record at the same digest with JournalError::MetadataMutation { digest }; first-write path skips the comparison.
notes: Loom is conditional on multi-process concurrency being introduced; Fjall linearizes per-key writes today. proof-planner should mark loom as not_applicable unless a bead adds intra-process concurrency.

domain_claim: DigestCheck::hierarchy_rank is strictly monotonic; checks_workflow_source / checks_compiled_ir / checks_full are rank-derived and thus transitively monotonic.
notes: Existing Kani coverage at crates/vb_storage/src/kani_vb_god2f_classification_recovery/recovery.rs (cover! for Full, assertion for rank monotonicity). proof-planner should bind.

domain_claim: verify_digests at DigestCheck::Full returns Err(RecoveryError::FullDigestCheckConfigMissing) when config is None, OR when cfg.action_abi_entries is None, OR when cfg.policy_entries is None. Empty slices are accepted (no entries to verify).
notes: Existing behavior tests at crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/tests.rs:1835-1911 cover all four branches (Full with full config, Full missing action entries, Full missing policy entries, WorkflowAndIr ignores config). proof-planner should bind.

domain_claim: check_action_abi_digests returns Err(RecoveryError::ActionAbiMismatch { action_id, expected, found }) on the FIRST mismatched entry; check_policy_digests returns Err(RecoveryError::PolicyDigestMismatch { step, expected, found }) on the FIRST mismatched entry.
notes: Behavior test coverage exists at crates/vb_storage/src/recover_tests.rs and crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/tests.rs. proof-planner should bind.

domain_claim: RecordKind::StepSucceeded has wire id 29; RecordKind::SlotWritten has wire id 12; record_kind() on JournalEvent::StepSucceeded returns StepSucceeded, on JournalEvent::SlotWrittenEvent returns SlotWritten; no other variant shares either id.
notes: Existing Kani harness already proves the two-variant pair. proof-planner should extend to ALL RecordKind variants (full injectivity across the enum) and bind to the canonical command.

notes: Hazard H-9 in hazard-analysis.md. proof-planner should bind as a cross-family coverage check; this is not strictly within the four named beads but is the immediate neighbor.
